description: The tallest Christmas tree that fits under a ceiling with a topper and stand, leaving a gap above, and how wide it will be. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

stand.description: What the stand adds under the tree, in inches; 0 when the tree's listed height includes it. Default 0.

topper.description: Topper height in inches; 0 for none. Default 10.

name: christmas_tree_size
title: Christmas tree size calculator
